test_cases.title: Sleep Deprivation Causes Heart Disease and Memory Loss
test_cases.transcript: Sleep deprivation is a serious issue affecting millions worldwide. Studies demonstrate that chronic lack of sleep increases the risk of cardiovascular disease and significantly impairs cognitive function and memory consolidation.
ground_truth_claims: Chronic lack of sleep increases the risk of cardiovascular disease
Sleep deprivation impairs cognitive function and memory consolidation
